description: Source code implementing AES-GCM-SIV encryption and decryption with optional assembly optimizations, including key setup, encryption/decryption routines, and Polyval-based authentication.

classes.name: gcm_siv_record_keys
classes.description: Structure holding per-record keys for GCM-SIV encryption and authentication.
